sourceRole: Official identity verification; regenerated black positive wordmark variant for customer ribbon readability.
prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit / background-extraction. Edit target: attached faithful ICONSIAM wordmark logo. Official brand identity verified at https://www.iconsiam.com/th. Create a clean high-resolution BLACK-on-transparent variant of EXACTLY this same ICONSIAM wordmark. Preserve every letter's elegant high contrast serif shape, ligature/spacing, and proportions. Change only: remove the entire black square background, recolor the existing white letters to opaque black. True alpha transparency outside and inside counters, no white rectangle, no gray checkerboard pixels, no shadow/glow or texture. Wide horizontal canvas about 4:1; wordmark fills 85% of width with modest even transparent clearspace. Text exact uppercase ICONSIAM. Do not add any extra text, icon, lines or decoration. Crisp edges, logo reproduction, no redesign.
